# SwitchUp

> > SwitchUp is the leading platform for discovering, comparing, and reviewing coding bootcamps with over 20,000 student reviews across specializations.

SwitchUp aggregates bootcamp reviews, rankings, and detailed program information across multiple tech disciplines including web development, data science, cybersecurity, and UX/UI design. The platform helps prospective students make informed decisions by providing transparent alumni feedback, career outcomes, and location-based bootcamp discovery.

## Key Topics

- Bootcamp Reviews
- Bootcamp Rankings
- Coding Bootcamps
- Web Development

- [Best Data Science Bootcamps](https://www.switchup.org/rankings/best-data-science-bootcamps): Top data science bootcamps ranked by student reviews and outcomes
- [Best Data Analytics Bootcamps](https://www.switchup.org/rankings/best-data-analytics-bootcamps): 2025 data analytics bootcamp rankings based on alumni reviews
- [Best Cybersecurity Bootcamps](https://www.switchup.org/rankings/best-cyber-security-bootcamps): Ranked cybersecurity bootcamps with alumni reviews and career outcomes
- [Best UX/UI Design Bootcamps](https://www.switchup.org/rankings/best-web-design-bootcamps): Top UX/UI design bootcamps ranked by student reviews and career support
- [Best Digital Marketing Bootcamps](https://www.switchup.org/rankings/best-digital-marketing-bootcamps): 2025 digital marketing bootcamp rankings with alumni feedback
